title: 5.6.2 Sub-build: One key, one sound
description: A key press plays one sound. Load it once, play it where the event happens, and hear the difference between once and every frame.
unit: 5.6 Pinball: a sound on a hit

steps.title: Run it first
steps.instructions: Press Space. The circle flashes but there is no sound: nothing is loaded and nothing plays.

steps.title: Load it once
steps.instructions: In `setup()`, load the sound once and keep it in a variable: `const blip = loadSound('/moshion/assets/coin.wav');`. It loads asynchronously, so a browser will not play it before the page has had a click or a key press.

steps.title: Play it on the key
steps.instructions: Inside an `if (kb.presses('space'))`, call `blip.play()`. Use `presses`, not `pressing`, so holding the key does not machine-gun the sound.
hints: Run it, then click the canvas once and press Space. A browser blocks sound until the student interacts.
A sound on every frame means the play call is outside the key test.

requirements.title: Loaded once
requirements.description: The sound is loaded in setup() and kept in a variable, not loaded inside draw(). Help: 5.6.1 (Reading: A sound on a hit)

requirements.title: Played on the key
requirements.description: Play is called inside a key test (presses or pressing), not every frame. Help: 5.6.1 (Reading: A sound on a hit)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a short moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: One key, one sound". The task: load one sound once in setup(), keep it in a variable, and play it inside a key test so it fires once per press rather than every frame. This is a sub-build: a small isolated program whose only job is this one mechanic, so judge the mechanic itself and not style. Accept any variable names, helper functions, arrow functions, ternaries and semicolons. A line that only exists in a comment or a string does not count. moSHion facts: colliding(b) is 0 while apart and counts frames while touching, so an if on it alone is true every frame of a touch; a stored "last frame" value makes it true once. .life = n counts down one per frame and deletes the sprite at 0. A sprite with collider 'none' is passed through and has its gravity off. loadSound(path) in setup() and sound.play() where the event happens; a browser will not play sound before the student's first click or key. Write short, plain notes for a 14-year-old, name the student's own line when something is missing, and never write corrected code.

rubric.title: One load
rubric.description: loadSound is called once, in setup() (or on the first event), not inside draw().

rubric.title: Played on the event
rubric.description: play() is called under a key test (presses or pressing), so it fires on the event and not every frame.
